label: D1 after an unrewarded visit to S2, when the agent is about to choose a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2). It fires when the previous trial ended unrewarded in S2 and the agent is about to choose a1. That covers both common-unrewarded a2 trials (the agent switches to a1) and rare-unrewarded a1 trials (the agent stays on a1). Read model-based, this is the step where an unrewarded S2 visit pushes the agent toward a1. It almost never fires after a rewarded trial (prev_reward==1 holds 11% of the mass) or after an unrewarded S1 visit. It is also restricted to D1 steps where the policy logit is moderately pro-a1 (choice between about -1.5 and 8); it is silent when the a1 preference is already very strong. The only FUTURE variable is action, which is the agent its own upcoming choice and so legitimate. The closest predicate using only observed variables, D1 & prev_reward==0 & prev_state==2, gets dev F1 0.57, and adding the upcoming choice raises it to 0.77. The tv(state,-1)!=1 form also lets in the window first trial, where the previous state is unknown. That adds mass recall but also most of the false positives (at rel -3 the hidden previous state was usually S1). Activation is higher on later steps in the window (rel +1 has the most activations) and the top quartile is 96% covered. The step-0 issue and the missing 13% of mass (weak activations after rewarded trials) keep this at partial.
